tools_helpful.evidence: Bootstrap ran (exit 0), produced MIGRATION-MAPPING.md and Test-Path self-check returned True (session-log turns 2-3).

tools_problematic.problem: Copied only 4 files (manifest + 3 .cs) and silently omitted the pages' .xaml markup, leaving orphaned code-behind with no signal to the agent.
tools_problematic.evidence: BOOTSTRAP: 'Copied 4 source files'; MIGRATION-MAPPING.md lists no .xaml rows; source .xaml exist only under obj\x64\Release (excluded by the bootstrap's bin/obj filter).

tool_limitations.limitation: Does not detect a *.xaml.cs copied without its sibling *.xaml, nor recover the markup that survives under the source build output.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: After the copy step, detect orphaned code-behind and recover the .xaml from obj/bin; warn on any unresolved.

tool_limitations.limitation: No explicit orphaned-code-behind check surfaced before the build cascade.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Optionally assert every *.xaml.cs partial page has a sibling *.xaml in the build set.

doc_errors.wrong: Assumes each *.xaml exists in source and is bootstrap-copied ('Copy each *.xaml from the source verbatim') with no procedure for when the authored .xaml is missing from source root.
doc_errors.correct: Add a 'missing/orphaned source XAML' pattern: recover from obj/bin, else author the page preserving x:Class/x:Name/handlers.

special_apis.special_handling: SDK-sample MainPage uses x:Bind in a DataTemplate; when the surrounding XAML compilation fails (missing sibling pages) this surfaces as WMC0909 'Cannot resolve DataType' / WMC1111 on the DataTemplate even though the Scenario type is present.

errors_encountered.error: WMC0909 Cannot resolve DataType local:Scenario; WMC1111 x:DataType missing; WMC9999 Xaml Internal Error (MarkupCompilePass2)
errors_encountered.root_cause: The XAML compile pass failed because Scenario1/Scenario2 pages had code-behind but no .xaml markup (orphaned), breaking the whole markup compilation.
errors_encountered.fix: Recover the missing .xaml from the source build output so every code-behind has its markup before building.

errors_encountered.error: CS0103 / CS1061 'InitializeComponent' does not exist (MainPage, Scenario1, Scenario2)
errors_encountered.root_cause: Cascading from the failed XAML compilation — no generated .g.cs because markup was absent.
errors_encountered.fix: Same recovery; resolves once markup compiles.

dev_agent_struggles.where: Reconstructing pages from scratch after the bootstrap omitted XAML
dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Agent hand-authored MainPage.xaml (pasted the SDKTemplate markup) and mixed namespaces (SDKTemplate vs project), then ran out of budget without authoring Scenario1/Scenario2 XAML or ever running a build.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: Log ends at turn 23 mid-edit; no build/validate ever ran.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: No signal that .xaml were missing; agent had to discover and re-author them manually, which is slow and error-prone.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Not resolved within the trial — app shipped non-compiling (score 0/11).
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Bootstrap auto-recovering orphaned .xaml from obj/bin and loudly flagging any unresolved, plus a PATTERNS section telling the agent to author missing markup first.

missing_tooling.need: Orphaned-code-behind detection + XAML recovery in the bootstrap.
missing_tooling.would_have_saved: The entire failure — the two Scenario pages that broke the build would have had their markup automatically.

env_issues.issue: UWP source checkout ships *.xaml.cs in the project root but the authored *.xaml only under obj\x64\Release (build output).
env_issues.workaround: Recover the .xaml from obj/bin during bootstrap.
